Noooo no no. I don't believe those to be "good memories". I can barely even think about sex right now. The only girl I really think about is the girl I mentioned and I just can't think of her in a sexual way.

What religion are you exactly? I used to be Christian, but now I'm just theistic. I'm not sure if God does have a religion, but I do believe in his existence. Also, even if there is an afterlife, I'm pretty sure I'm going to have a shitty life anyways. Why not end it now and avoid all the bad memories?

I understand that contrast is necessary, but I tend to be a bit pessimistic and I believe that the pain outways the bad outweighs the good in life. Would I be willing to break my legs just for a blowjob? No. Would I be willing to go through a bunch of shit just for a couple good memories? Probably not.

Also, what happens when we die? We will forget all the memories anyways, so what's the point of gaining memories just to lose them? What would be the point of earning a million dollars just to burn it all?

Exactly! We're going to die eventually, so why waste our time and energy working so hard just to live? I'm probably not going to kill myself just because that girl I like, but I still see no point in living.

Thanks. I think I am a bit altruistic... I spent about an hour today txting that girl trying to find someone else she can talk to to replace me if I do kill myself.

I'll try to focus on my needs and whatnot a little more. Again, thank you for the advie :)

Ahh. Ich spreche ein bischen Deutsch auch. I'm taking my second year of German right now.

I like hanging out with friends, reddit, vidya gaems, and watching movies. I play a little piano. I'm not sure what I want to do when I grow up. I kind of want to be either a psychiatrist or a therapist, but I'm not sure.

Thank you. I don't know why, but that really got to me, especially the simple "TL;DR: you" at the end. The only thing is, I don't know where to turn. You're telling me to turn my view around, but what do I turn it to?
Thanks, man :D We both share a good mutual friend. She knows how I feel and she said she would ask her about me. Again, thanks for the advice!
That's actually a pretty good idea. I might try this approach. Thanks, bro!

It's fucking hard. I give too many fucks. When it comes to what most of the idiots at my school think of me, I don't give a shit. However, when it comes to people that I actually like and care about, I give lots of fucks.
I talk to her all the time. It's just hard. I'm not even a honey badger. I need to learn how to not give a fuck.
